title: Receipts se fiat era tak
instruction: Chaar milestones chronological track par rakho. Receipts, state notes aur compulsory stage ko ek event mat bana dena.

pieces.label: 7th c. | Tang | Receipts
pieces.right: Track Tang receipts se shuru hua; later state notes ka milestone alag hai.
pieces.wrong: 7th-century receipts ko 1023 ke baad rakhne se earlier form later ho jaayega.

pieces.label: 1023 | Song | State notes
pieces.right: Receipts ke baad Song state notes ka 1023 milestone juda.
pieces.wrong: Song state notes Tang receipts ke baad aur Yuan compulsory stage se pehle hain.

pieces.label: 1275 | Yuan | Compulsory
pieces.right: Book ka Yuan compulsory stage juda; yeh sirf receipts wala stage nahi.
pieces.wrong: 1275 ko 1023 se pehle rakhne se stages ka chronological order ulat jaayega.

pieces.label: 1971 | Modern | Fiat era
pieces.right: Modern fiat-era milestone aakhir mein aaya; earlier paper forms ko modern fiat ke barabar nahi maana.
pieces.wrong: 1971 ko medieval milestones ke beech rakhne se centuries ka historical order tootega.

win: Tang receipts → Song state notes → Yuan compulsory → modern fiat era.
